case.title: The Northline Incident
case.description: Bellwether · 17 October 2026. A missing report. An unfamiliar search. A trail of permissions.

evidence.title: The first signal
evidence.content: At 08:42 a valid contractor session searched the archive from an unfamiliar network. A login alone did not establish malicious intent.

evidence.title: The finding
evidence.content: At 11:40 the team concluded: the injection attempt failed, the restricted read was denied, and the missing report was reclassified. The unfamiliar login still requires a separate credential investigation. There is no evidence in this case of successful data extraction.
